description: Hey, welcome to NEBULENS! I'm a final-year CSE (AI & ML) student from CIT, Chennai, joining virtually. I'm passionate about space, astronomy and exploring the universe. I enjoy AI/ML, computer vision, object detection and Python. Looking for curious minds interested in space science, AI/ML, software development, data science or visualisation. No need to be an expert! Bring your ideas and enthusiasm. Feel free to join. Let's build something out of this world!
